options.title: 590 billionaires are too poor for the Forbes 400
options.first_line: Five hundred and ninety American billionaires are too poor for the Forbes 400.
options.first_frame: A velvet rope across the golden door of the Forbes 400, a crowd of tiny billionaires in suits stuck behind it, the sign on the door reading $4.4B TO GET IN and 590 over the crowd.

options.title: Elon Musk is worth $908B. 590 billionaires can't make his list
options.first_line: Elon Musk is worth nine hundred and eight billion dollars, and five hundred and ninety billionaires are too poor to join him on the Forbes 400.
options.first_frame: A giant gold stack labelled ELON MUSK $908B towering at the top of the frame, a crowd of small billionaires labelled 590 locked out below a rope marked FORBES 400.

options.title: $4.4 billion makes you last on the Forbes 400
options.first_line: Four point four billion dollars makes you the poorest person on the Forbes 400.
options.first_frame: One billionaire on the bottom rung of a huge gold ladder labelled FORBES 400 that climbs out of the top of the frame, a sign at his feet reading LAST PLACE $4.4B.

why: "Billionaires too poor" is a paradox a stranger stops for in one second, and the first frame shows both figures (590 locked out, $4.4B to get in) without sound, where B splits into two facts and C has less tension.
